name: T3 Code environment over SSH
description: Makes a dev container a T3 Code environment: an SSH entry point reachable only through `docker exec` (no daemon, no port), a data volume behind ~/.t3, and a name for the environment. The T3 Code desktop app installs and starts a server of its own version when it connects, so the feature does not change when T3 Code updates.

strict.description: Fail the build when the image cannot run the feature. Set to false to skip the feature instead, for example when it is applied to every dev container through dev.containers.defaultFeatures.
